prompt: How many Fields medalists were affiliated with a French institution at the time they received the award?
answer: 17. The IHES/CNRS release counted 16 Fields medals awarded to researchers whose institutions were affiliated with CNRS as of 2022; Hong Wang’s 2026 medal adds one more, since she was a professor at France’s IHES when awarded.
